# 00000009674

**TAG-04 ★** — source: 308_算术超越.md

**English.** Definition: Christol's p-adic E-functions: p-adic analytic functions generated by automatic sequences are the p-adic analogue of Siegel E-functions. Conjecture: p-adic E-functions satisfy transcendence of values at algebraic points parallel to the complex case: algebraic relations among values are exactly generated by functional relations; and the criterion is finitely verifiable by automaton minimization algorithms. (Christol E-function transcendence)

**中文。** 定义：Christol 的 p-adic E 函数：自动数列生成的 p-adic 解析函数是 Siegel E 函数的 p-adic 类比。猜想：p-adic E 函数在代数点的值满足与复情形平行的超越性：值的代数关系恰由函数关系生成；判据可通过自动机最小化算法有限验证。（Christol E 函数超越性）
